events.title: Microchip to Report Q4 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
events.body: MCHP reports fiscal Q4 earnings on May 7, guiding sales of $1.26B and earnings of 48-52 cents per share as backlog, mix shifts and easing inventory support growth.

events.body: Get a deeper insight into the potential performance of Microchip Tech (MCHP) for the quarter ended March 2026 by going beyond Wall Street's top-and-bottom-line estimates and examining the estimates for some of its key metrics.
